# livekit_project_settings (Resource)

The settings of an existing LiveKit Cloud project. The project itself is not created or deleted: creating this resource changes the settings that are set, and destroying it only stops managing them. Settings left out of the configuration are not changed, and they are not watched for drift. Changing them needs the admin role (`3`) in the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only the settings written here are managed; the rest are left as they are.
resource "livekit_project_settings" "this" {
  enable_auto_create        = false
  require_explicit_dispatch = true
  enabled_codecs            = ["video/VP8", "video/H264", "audio/opus", "audio/red"]
  pinned_regions            = ["us"]

  enable_user_data_recording = true
  enable_user_data_training  = false
  enable_pii_redaction       = true
  pii_redaction_categories   = ["ssn", "credit-card", "email-address", "phone-number"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `disable_token_endpoint` (Boolean) Turn off the project's sandbox token endpoint. Left as it is when not set.
- `enable_analytics` (Boolean) Collect analytics for the project. Left as it is when not set.
- `enable_auto_create` (Boolean) Let the first participant to join a room that does not exist yet create it. Left as it is when not set.
- `enable_egress_auto_retry` (Boolean) Retry a failed egress automatically. Left as it is when not set.
- `enable_egress_backup_storage` (Boolean) Keep an egress that fails to upload in LiveKit backup storage for 7 days. Left as it is when not set.
- `enable_inference_region_restriction` (Boolean) Restrict LiveKit Inference to models in the project's data region. Left as it is when not set.
- `enable_pii_redaction` (Boolean) Redact PII from recorded session data. Turned on with no saved categories, it redacts LiveKit's default set; see `pii_redaction_categories`. Left as it is when not set.
- `enable_remote_unmute` (Boolean) Let an admin unmute the tracks of another participant. Left as it is when not set.
- `enable_user_data_recording` (Boolean) Record traces, transcripts and audio of agent sessions for agent observability. Data recorded earlier stays readable when it is turned off. Left as it is when not set.
- `enable_user_data_training` (Boolean) Let LiveKit use the project's observability data to improve models and services. Left as it is when not set.
- `enabled_codecs` (Set of String) Media codecs the project allows, by MIME type, such as `video/VP8` and `audio/opus`. The API cannot clear the list, so it needs at least one. Left as it is when not set.
- `name` (String) The project name. Left as it is when not set.
- `pii_redaction_categories` (Set of String) PII categories to redact, by the short names the LiveKit CLI uses, such as `ssn`, `credit-card` and `email-address`. The API cannot clear the list, so it needs at least one, and turning redaction off keeps it. Left as it is when not set.
- `pinned_regions` (Set of String) SFU regions to pin the project's traffic to, such as `us`. An empty set removes the pins. Left as it is when not set. This is not where session data is kept; see `user_data_region`.
- `project_id` (String) Project (`p_...`) whose settings to manage. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
- `require_explicit_dispatch` (Boolean) Reject an agent server that registers without an explicit agent name, so an accidental auto-dispatch server cannot connect. Left as it is when not set.
- `sfu_allow_pause` (Boolean) Let the SFU pause video tracks when subscribers are congested. Left as it is when not set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the project was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `id` (String) The project ID.
- `subdomain` (String) The project subdomain, which forms `url`.
- `url` (String) The project's LiveKit server URL (`wss://...`).
- `user_data_region` (String) Where the project keeps session data. It is set when the project is created and cannot change.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace that holds the project (`wo_...`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the settings of a project by its ID.
terraform import livekit_project_settings.this p_abc123
```
